Check expected exam dates, practical schedule and how to download PDF By Trending Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 06, 2026, 08:22:00 AM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis CBSE is anticipated to release the date sheet for the 2027 Class 10 and Class 12 exams. These examinations are expected to occur from February to April 2027. Practical assessments for these classes will begin earlier in November 2026 and January 2027. Students should check the official CBSE website for updates and official announcements regularly. The official timetable will be accessible for download once released from cbse.gov.in.
 PTI CBSE Date Sheet 2027: When will class 10, 12 timetable be released? Check expected exam dates, practical schedule and how to download PDF
 The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) is likely to announce the timetable for the 2027 board examinations soon on its official website. Students preparing for the upcoming Class 10 and Class 12 annual examinations will be able to access the date sheet at cbse .gov.in once it is released.
 According to the board's official information, the CBSE Class 10 and Class 12 examinations for the 2026-27 academic session will be conducted between February and April 2027.
 When will the CBSE date sheet be released?
The CBSE is expected to announce the date sheet soon, although the board has not yet confirmed an official release date. Based on the examination schedule followed in previous years, the Class 10 and Class 12 board exams for 2027 are likely to be held between February and March. More than 45 lakh students are expected to take the examinations. The papers are likely to be conducted in offline, pen-and-paper mode, with each exam expected to have a duration of two and a half hours, subject to the board's official guidelines. 
 CBSE Board Exams 2027: Important Details
 Board: Central Board of Secondary Education
 Examination: Class 10 and Class 12 board exams
 Academic session: 2026–27
 Date sheet status: Awaited
 Expected release: Soon; no official date confirmed
 Expected exam period: February to April 2027
 Official website: cbse.gov.in
 Note: The CBSE board examination timetable for 2027 has not yet been released. Students should regularly visit the official website for the latest announcements and updates.
 CBSE Board Exams 2027: Practical Exam Schedule
The board has also announced the schedule for practical examinations, project assessments and internal assessments for the 2026-27 academic session. In winter-bound schools, these assessments for Classes 10 and 12 will take place from November 9 to December 6, 2026.
 Live Events
 For other CBSE-affiliated schools across India and abroad, practical examinations for the 2026-27 session are scheduled to commence on January 1, 2027.
 CBSE Date Sheet 2027: How To Download Class 10, 12 Timetable
Once the timetable is published, students will be able to download the CBSE Class 10 and Class 12 date sheets by following these steps:
 1. Visit the official CBSE website, cbse.gov.in.
2. Find the link for the CBSE Class 10 or Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 on the homepage.
3. Select the relevant link to access the timetable PDF.
4. Go through the subject-wise examination dates and timings carefully.
5. Download the PDF and save it for future reference.
